panel.name: Cbox CMS
panel.page_missing.title: This page is not part of the panel
panel.page_missing.body: The server asked for the page "{page}", which this build of the panel does not have. Reload the panel; if the page is still missing, the panel and the server are of different versions.
panel.title: {page} · {name}
panel.not_found.title: Page not found
panel.not_found.body: The panel has no page at this address. The page may have moved, or the link that brought you here may be out of date.
panel.not_found.home: Go to the start of the panel
panel.login.title: Sign in
panel.login.heading: Welcome back
panel.login.description: Sign in to edit and publish across your sites.
panel.login.failed: The email or the password is not right. Check them and try again.
panel.login.rate_limited: There have been too many attempts to sign in. Wait a few minutes and try again.
panel.login.reason.required: Sign in to use the panel.
panel.login.reason.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
panel.login.reason.ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
panel.login.reason.revoked: Your access has changed since you signed in. Sign in again.
panel.login.reason.password_changed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
panel.home.title: Start
panel.home.body: You are signed in to the panel.
panel.forgot.title: Reset your password
panel.forgot.description: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
panel.forgot.requested: If an account has this email, a link to reset its password is on its way. The link works for {minutes} minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
panel.reset.title: Choose a new password
panel.reset.description: Choose a new password for your account. You will be signed in with it.
panel.reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A sentence of a few unrelated words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
panel.reset.too_short: The password needs at least 12 characters.
panel.reset.too_long: The password is too long. Use at most 1024 bytes.
panel.reset.breached: This password is known from data breaches. Choose another one.
panel.reset.check_unavailable: The password could not be checked just now. Try again in a moment.
panel.reset.invalid: This link no longer works: it has been used, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
panel.showcase.title: One place for every site, every page and every change.
panel.showcase.description: Edit, publish and see when a change is live on every site.
panel.showcase.card.title: A published change
panel.showcase.card.note: The receipt of every change says which of these steps it has reached.
panel.host.failed_title: A part from {addon} could not be shown
panel.host.failed_body: The rest of the page works. If this part is missing for long, tell whoever looks after the panel's add-ons.
panel.host.unavailable_body: The parts {addon} adds to this page are left out. The rest of the page works.
panel.host.step_failed: {addon} stopped this because one of its steps failed.
panel.host.step_timed_out: {addon} stopped this because one of its steps took too long.
panel.host.confirm_body: The command runs as you, with the values above.
panel.points.title: Panel points
panel.points.none_body: A page declares its points with #[PanelPoint]; cms:panel:stories then gives each a story here.
panel.points.order_rule: Lowest priority first, then the addon's namespace, then the contribution's id.
panel.points.host: The point as a page renders it
panel.points.asked: A page asks this point for its contributions while it works, so it renders nothing of its own here.
panel.points.command_form_field: Field input of the command form
panel.points.command_form_dryrun: Dry run of the command form
panel.palette.label: Command palette
panel.palette.search: Find a page or a command
panel.palette.unavailable_title: The commands could not be loaded
panel.palette.unavailable_body: The pages and commands you may use could not be read. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.
panel.palette.refused_title: The panel could not read your commands
panel.palette.refused_body: The read was refused. Sign out and in again; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.

panel.action.actor.activate.description: Make a pending actor active, the last step of a registration.

panel.action.entry.revise.description: Save a new revision of an entry.
panel.action.entry.publish.title: Publish an entry
panel.action.entry.publish.description: Release a revision and put it live at its home placement.
panel.action.entry.unpublish.title: Unpublish an entry
panel.action.entry.unpublish.description: Take an entry off its placement and out of delivery.
panel.action.grant.assign.title: Assign a grant
panel.action.grant.assign.description: Give an actor a role on a node, allowing or denying.
panel.action.grant.revoke.title: Revoke a grant
panel.action.grant.revoke.description: End a grant an actor holds.
panel.action.placement.create.title: Create a placement
panel.action.placement.create.descriptio: Place an entry on a node with its slug and canonical choice.
panel.action.placement.set_window.title: Set a placement's window
panel.action.placement.set_window.descri: Set from when and until when a placement is live.
panel.action.role.create.title: Create a role
panel.action.role.create.description: Create a role with a handle, a classification ceiling and the commands it may run.
panel.action.role.set_permissions.title: Set a role's permissions
panel.action.role.set_permissions.descri: Replace the commands and reads a role may run.
panel.action.variant.release.title: Release a variant
panel.action.variant.release.description: Release a revision of an entry's variant so it can go live.

panel.account_me.title: Who am I
panel.account_me.description: Your account as the panel knows it: your profile, your actor and the access you hold.
panel.account_me.name: Name
panel.account_me.grants_description: Each grant gives you a role on a node and everything below it, or keeps it from you.
panel.account_me.no_grants_body: An administrator gives you a role on a node. Until then you can sign in and see this page.
panel.account_me.refused: The panel could not read your account.
panel.account_me.unavailable_title: Your account could not be shown
panel.account_me.unavailable_body: The panel got no answer it could read. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.

panel.command_form.unsupported_title: This command's form cannot be shown
panel.command_form.unsupported_body: The command's schema uses "{keyword}" at {pointer}, which the form has no field for. Run the command through the REST API or the CLI instead, or ask whoever maintains it to keep its schema to the supported subset.
panel.command_form.options_description: Choose how long to wait for the change. Try the command first to see what it would change without saving.
panel.command_form.invalid_title: The form was not sent. Check the fields marked below.
panel.command_form.failed_title: The command could not be run
panel.command_form.failed_body: The panel got no answer. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.
panel.command_form.committed_body: The change is saved. Running the form again makes a new change.
panel.command_form.held_body: An add-on marked something below. Fix what is marked, and tick what needs your confirmation.
panel.command_form.disabled_title: The command cannot be run now
panel.command_form.acknowledge: I have read this and want to go on
The id of the pending actor to activate.
panel.action.actor.activate.field.versio: The version of the actor you read.
panel.action.entry.create.field.entry.de: The new entry's id, which you make.
panel.action.entry.create.field.type.des: The id of the entry's type.
panel.action.entry.create.field.home.des: The id of the node that owns the entry's content.
panel.action.entry.create.field.fields.d: The fields of the first revision, as JSON by handle; the type's schema decides what they must be.
panel.action.entry.revise.field.entry.de: The id of the entry to revise.
panel.action.entry.revise.field.fields.d: The fields of the new revision, as JSON by handle.
The version of the entry's shared variant you read.
panel.action.entry.publish.field.entry.d: The id of the entry to publish.
The locale the placement goes live in, such as da or en-GB.
panel.action.entry.publish.field.placeme: The id of the entry's home placement.
The version of the home placement you read.
panel.action.entry.publish.field.revisio: The number of the revision to release, or none for a type without stages.
panel.action.entry.publish.field.version: The version of the entry's shared variant you read.
When the placement is live; leave it unset to go live now.
When it goes live, RFC 3339 with an offset, such as 2026-10-07T09:00:00+02:00.
When it stops being live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or empty for ever.
panel.action.entry.unpublish.field.entry: The id of the entry to unpublish.
panel.action.entry.unpublish.field.versi: The version of the entry's shared variant you read.
panel.action.variant.release.field.entry: The id of the entry whose variant is released.
panel.action.variant.release.field.revis: The number of the revision to release.
panel.action.variant.release.field.versi: The version of the entry's shared variant you read.
panel.action.grant.assign.field.grant.de: The new grant's id, which you make.
panel.action.grant.assign.field.actor.de: The id of the actor to get the grant, an active staff or service actor.
panel.action.grant.assign.field.role.des: The id of the role to grant.
panel.action.grant.assign.field.node.des: The id of the node the grant holds on, with the subtree below it.
panel.action.grant.assign.field.effect.d: Allow gives the role's permissions on the node; deny keeps them from it.
The locales the grant holds in, each once; leave it unset for every locale.
panel.action.grant.revoke.field.grant.de: The id of the grant to end.
The version of the grant you read.
panel.action.placement.create.field.entr: The id of the entry to place.
panel.action.placement.create.field.node: The id of the node the placement is on.
panel.action.placement.create.field.plac: The new placement's id, which you make.
panel.action.placement.create.field.site: The id of the site the placement is on.
panel.action.placement.create.field.slug: The last segment of the placement's path in each locale.
The locale, such as da or en-GB.
1 to 255 characters without a slash or white space.
The locale the window applies in, such as da or en-GB.
The version of the placement you read.
When the placement is live; leave it unset to hide the placement in the locale.
When it goes live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or empty for since always.
When it stops being live, RFC 3339 with an offset, or empty for ever.
panel.action.role.create.field.role.desc: The new role's id, which you make.
panel.action.role.create.field.handle.de: A lower-case letter followed by at most 62 lower-case letters, digits or underscores.
panel.action.role.create.field.ceiling.d: The highest classification the role may read.
panel.action.role.create.field.permissio: The commands and reads the role may run, each by name, such as entry.create.
The id of the role to change.
The version of the role you read.
The role's new permissions in full, each by name, such as entry.create.
panel.access.unavailable_title: This page could not be shown
panel.access.unavailable_body: The panel got no answer it could read. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.
panel.access.failed_title: The change could not be made
panel.access.failed_body: The panel got no answer for it. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell whoever looks after the panel.
panel.problem.unauthorized: You may not do this. An administrator who holds grant.assign can give you a role that may.
panel.problem.validation_failed: Something in the form is not right. Correct the fields marked below and try again.
panel.problem.version_conflict: Someone changed this since you read it. Reload the page to see what it is now, then try again.
panel.problem.grant_escalation_refused: You can only give what you hold yourself: every permission of the role on this node and in these languages, and a classification ceiling no higher than your own. Choose a role within your own rights, or ask someone who holds the role's permissions here to assign it.
panel.problem.step_up_required: This role is administrative: it may change roles, grants or who is active, so assigning it needs step-up, a fresh sign-in, which the panel does not offer yet. Choose a role that is not administrative, or ask whoever looks after the installation.
panel.problem.actor_not_active: This actor is not active, so it can hold no grant. Activate the actor first, or choose another.
panel.roles.title: Roles
panel.roles.description: What each role lets its holders do, and how far they may read. A role is granted to someone on a node; the grants page shows who holds what where.
panel.roles.refused: The roles could not be read.
panel.roles.command_refused: The change was refused. Nothing was saved.
panel.roles.cannot_create: You may list roles but not create or change them. An administrator who holds role.create and role.set_permissions can.
panel.roles.create_description: A role is a set of permissions with a ceiling on what its holders may read. It is granted to nobody until you assign it on the grants page.
panel.roles.handle_hint: A lowercase word such as editors: letters, digits and underscores, up to 63 characters.
panel.roles.handle_invalid: Use a lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
panel.roles.ceiling_hint: The highest classification the role's holders may read through it, no higher than your own.
panel.roles.permissions_hint: The commands and reads the role may run. You can give only what you hold yourself.
panel.roles.edit_description: The full list replaces the role's permissions. Everyone who holds the role gets the new list at once.
panel.roles.unchanged: The permissions are as they were. Change them to save.
panel.roles.empty_body: Create the first role to give colleagues access.
panel.roles.empty_body_readonly: An administrator creates the first role.
panel.grants.title: Grants
panel.grants.description: Who holds which role where. A grant gives an actor a role on a node and everything below it, or keeps the role from them there.
panel.grants.refused: The grants could not be read.
panel.grants.command_refused: The change was refused. Nothing was saved.
panel.grants.cannot_assign: You may list grants but not assign or revoke them. An administrator who holds grant.assign and grant.revoke can.
panel.grants.assign_description: Give a member of staff a role on a node and everything below it. You can give only roles you hold yourself, where you hold them.
panel.grants.pickers_loading: Loading the staff, roles and nodes
panel.grants.picker_unavailable: The choices could not be loaded. Close the form and open it again.
panel.grants.picker_refused: You may not read these choices.
panel.grants.actor_hint: Find them by name or email.
panel.grants.role_hint: The permissions the grant gives, or keeps out.
panel.grants.node_hint: The grant holds on this node and everything below it.
panel.grants.node_empty_body: You reach no node where a grant can be assigned.
panel.grants.node_unavailable_title: The nodes could not be loaded
panel.grants.effect_allow_hint: Gives the role's permissions on the node and below it.
panel.grants.effect_deny_hint: Keeps the role's permissions from the node and below it, even where a grant above allows them.
panel.grants.locales_hint: The languages the grant holds in. Leave it empty for every language.
panel.grants.revoke_body: {actor} loses the role {role} on {node} from now. The grant stays in the history as ended.
panel.grants.row_actions: Actions for the grant of {role} to {actor}
panel.grants.empty_body: Assign the first grant to give a colleague a role on a node.
panel.grants.empty_body_readonly: An administrator assigns the first grant.
